offer.text: The stonework around our well by the village center has crumbled. Lay eight stone bricks around it and it'll hold another lifetime.

accept.text: Good. Build it sturdy — the whole village draws from that well.

in_progress.text: How's the well coming along? Stone bricks, near the center.

ready.text: Solid as bedrock now. Fine work.

complete.text: The well will serve us for years thanks to you. The village thanks you.
